summary: Wrote a nine-phase implementation plan for the countermodel half of BimodalLib, integrating the research report in full. Phases land a PointTruth-generic CountermodelEntry type, both TRANSFER theorems, one kernel-checked entry at each of the three admitted grades, registration of the hand-built refutations in the tree, lookup up to atom renaming, the index census and near-miss invariant, tests, and the docs/record reconciliation. Bulk admission of the pipeline's 1,047 gated-tableau statements is a stated Non-Goal on the research report's measured line-cost FAIL, consistent with M20's own DONE WHEN clause. The plan validates with 0 warnings and its Lean Challenge Statements block compiles against the project toolchain.
